purpose: 기존 B의 두 encoder 층 사이에서 경과시간에 따른 상태 전파를 추가하여, 사건의 발생 간격과 관측 내용의 지속·변화를 함께 처리하는 Backbone 후보를 검증한다.

hypothesis.claim_to_test: Explicit elapsed-time state propagation adds useful inductive bias beyond giving the same observed duration features to attention and gates.
hypothesis.example: With state-write inputs held fixed, a longer observed gap retains less of the previous state. In a full model, gates and values also depend on duration-containing first-layer representations, so full predictions need not be monotone in the gap.

authorized_now: local source and frozen validation-evidence review
scope.previous_pair_message_candidate: Additional seeds and Instacart extension remain on hold.
scope.future_execution: A new, concrete execution contract and user approval are required; previous approvals, server assignments and deadlines are not inherited.

evidence.interpretation_boundary: Previous results motivate a different hypothesis, but do not establish a missing elapsed-time mechanism as their cause. Historical experiments with different time likelihoods are not quantitative controls.

design_twice.candidate: bounded elapsed-time state transport between encoder blocks
design_twice.information_processing: Propagate a small learned state, decay retained content by observed time, and write current causal context before the second attention block.
design_twice.reason: One explicit transition-clock change has a same-capacity event-clock control; zero-initialized output preserves initial B behavior; masks and state bounds admit direct tests.
design_twice.risk: State may duplicate information already available to attention, lose useful long-gap context or add cost without benefit.

design_twice.information_processing: Process local event patterns at fine resolution and completed causal block summaries at coarse resolution.
design_twice.reason: Materially different topology, but block boundaries, compression, equal-capacity controls and initial B equivalence change several factors together. It is a distinct future alternative if this single-axis test fails.

distinction_from_prior_axes.difference: No inner gradient update, prediction-error write, learned parameter memory or circular slot search; this state is a bounded activation vector.
No recent/old prefix banks or query-weighted hidden-difference retrieval; propagation uses an explicit elapsed clock.
No slot-wise cumulative mean or content-addressed read; generic recurrent bottleneck was already listed as an alternative, so recurrence itself is not claimed new.
No predecessor-successor record bank or pre/post-pool value comparison.
Time and quantity retain one jointly trained shared representation and one state route.
No fixed local convolution of Q/K/V; the new operation transports a recurrent activation between blocks.
No query-event pair gate; first-layer context determines affine state coefficients before second-layer attention.

NHP already uses temporal decay. Here coefficients depend on first-layer context, not the new previous state, enabling an affine scan within the Titan hybrid. This is not a claim to invent continuous-time recurrence.

architecture.flow: unchanged observed log1p(dt,quantity) inputs and positions -> first B encoder block -> state transport residual -> second B encoder block -> original static Hard-LMM -> unchanged shared time and quantity heads
equations: u_i = LayerNorm_no_affine(h_i), epsilon=1e-5, over hidden channels only
d_i = exp(-lambda * delta_i) for elapsed-clock candidate; exp(-lambda * 1) for event-clock control
A_i = (1 - g_i) * d_i; B_i = g_i * v_i
h'_i = h_i + U s_i on observed positions; state correction is zero elsewhere
architecture.coefficient_dependency: V/G consume causal h_i, which can summarize earlier observations. They do not consume s_(i-1). All parameters, including original B, train jointly.
architecture.state_lifetime: Rebuild from zero for every sample and forward call. No state across windows, series, batches or epochs.
excluded_changes: gradient detach or raw auxiliary loss

same_parameter_control.only_intended_difference: Explicit state transition clock: delta_i versus 1 on each observed event.
identical: tensor shapes and trainable parameter count
same_parameter_control.time_information_available_to_control: The control still sees duration through first-layer h and its learned gates/values. This is an explicit temporal-dynamics comparison, not time-information access versus no time information.
same_parameter_control.identity_case: For identical inputs, parameters and masks, all observed delta_i=1 implies identical control/candidate state outputs.

initialization.V: Bias-free Linear(64,8), ordinary initialization inside an isolated RNG context.
initialization.G: Linear(64,8) weight initialized exactly zero; trainable bias b=logit(1/16).
initialization.rho: Trainable vector of length 8, initialized inverse_softplus(log(2)/event_free_half_life). Values fixed before validation; no per-dataset search.
initialization.common_rng: Construct/copy common B tensors and preserve caller RNG; added modules must not shift subsequent dropout or batch RNG. Added tensors equal between the two new arms.
initialization.B_equivalence: On the runner's canonical right-padded observed-history layout, compare observed prediction outputs, objective and common-B preclip gradients before training.
initialization.staged_gradient_activation: U should receive a gradient initially. V/G/b/rho may have zero gradients until U moves; test their gradients with nonzero U, nondegenerate observations and a nonzero previous state.
initialization.clipping_caveat: New U gradients affect the full gradient norm; first clipped optimizer updates need not equal B even when common preclip gradients match.
initialization.retention_caveat: c=1..128 is event-free time decay only. g=1/16 yields event-only retention half-life about 10.74 observations, and c=128 with delta=1 gives about 9.91 observations. This design does not guarantee long-term retention or extend the input window.

time_scale.definition: Reuse the common observed-time-head's frozen train-only median of loader-transformed training target durations. Do not fit on validation or estimate anew in this design step.
time_scale.derivation_source: paper/scripts/run_count_aware_tpp_backbone_control.py::derive_train_time_contract uses train target_splits and np.quantile(target_dts, 0.50); paper/scripts/run_pair_message_execution.py::time_interface binds the frozen statistics and duration identity.
time_scale.requirements: Positive finite scalar bound to train data/target-duration checksums and source identity; candidate/control carry the same value. Implementation must reject invalid scale and invalid observed durations.
time_scale.application: Normalize only the new recurrence clock. Original B input features and head scaling remain unchanged.
time_scale.invariance_scope: Multiplying duration and scale by the same factor preserves the recurrence clock; this does not imply unit invariance of the entire B model.

causality_and_masks.observed: original_valid_mask & memory_write_mask (or original_valid_mask if write mask absent)
causality_and_masks.sanitize_first: Replace non-observed raw dt/quantity with finite zero before any log, projection or gate. Mask h before new projections; never multiply NaN by zero as sanitization.
causality_and_masks.observed_transition: Use only duration of the current observed event, including its preceding observed interval as represented by the frozen loader. Never consume next-event target duration.
causality_and_masks.padding: original_valid=false -> A=1,B=0; no state clock advance, zero correction.
causality_and_masks.withheld_event: original_valid=true and observed=false -> A=0,B=0; reset only the added state path, zero correction. No hidden duration accumulation across this boundary.
causality_and_masks.reset_scope: A state reset does not erase earlier observed history from first-layer attention. Withheld values must have no influence through either encoder block.
causality_and_masks.mask_plumbing: Retain original_valid and observed separately through the helper. Both B blocks use the sanitized observed-token attention mask; do not copy a wrapper that discards original_valid before the recurrence can distinguish padding from withheld boundaries.
causality_and_masks.persistent_memory: Existing persistent attention keys/values are not event rows and never advance this state.
causality_and_masks.positions: Preserve canonical runner event order and position IDs. Padding-insertion invariance is a recurrence property; full-model tests must preserve observed position IDs.
causality_and_masks.target_selection: Retain existing observed history-position selection; target dt/quantity are used only in supervised losses after prediction.

math_and_cost.state_bound: For finite g in [0,1], d in [0,1], v in [-1,1] and s_start=0, every state channel remains in [-1,1]. This does not bound all hidden states or gradients.
math_and_cost.affine_composition: Earlier (a,b), later (c,d) compose to (c*a, c*b+d), elementwise. Floating-point implementations need tolerance-based agreement.
math_and_cost.implementation_first: Sequential affine scan is the correctness oracle. Select a production scan only after CPU gradient/restore checks and measured device cost.
math_and_cost.work: Added projections O(batch*length*hidden*state); sequential scan O(batch*length*state). Work-efficient parallel scan can have O(log length) depth; naive Hillis-Steele instead has O(length log length) work.
math_and_cost.saved_state: The state sequence itself uses O(batch*length*state). The selected out-of-place Hillis-Steele implementation may retain O(batch*length*state*log(length)) autograd intermediates across scan levels; no new query-event pair tensor. Overall backbone attention remains quadratic.
math_and_cost.actual_parameters_and_cuda_cost: unverified until implementation and device qualification
math_and_cost.numerics: Finite observed inputs and nonnegative durations required. Large-gap exponential underflow to zero is acceptable; NaN/Inf updates are failures. Existing float32 training is the initial target; mixed precision is not authorized by this design.

implementation_map.integration: Local subclass/helper: explicit first block -> state residual -> second block; reuse static Hard-LMM/shared head behavior. Preserve default B route. Add dedicated tests; do not modify frozen prior source bundles.
checkpoint_identity: source file checksums, not Git revision alone
implementation_map.load_policy: Strictly reject clock, scale, architecture or source identity mismatch. Sample-local s is recomputed; it is not a persistent checkpoint memory.

verification_required_before_gpu_contrac: Full-model initial B output/objective/common preclip gradient and RNG equality on canonical batches.
Future, target and padding value poisoning cannot affect earlier observed predictions; masked NaN/Inf sanitized before operations; target gradient zero.
Sequential and chosen scan forward/backward agreement; all-delta-one control/candidate agreement.
Every new parameter receives finite, nontrivial activated-path gradients; sequence reset and independent sample batching verified.
Exact state_dict, optimizer, RNG and next-update replay; mismatched clock/scale/source rejected.
Identical train/validation batch content and order; strict earliest finite raw-RMSE selector, stored metrics from that checkpoint, interrupted resume identity.
Measured CPU cost plus an explicit approved CUDA qualification plan; no runtime feasibility claim from asymptotic analysis alone.

future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.initial_scope: Intermittent and Taxi, seed42, same dataset on same host; concrete assignment and budget unfrozen. Instacart/additional seeds remain outside this design's execution scope.
future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.preserve: Recorded positive-integer lognormal time likelihood plus log-quantity MSE, shared heads, no auxiliary objective; same B initialization, train-only statistics, batches, optimizer, clipping, exposure and selectors across arms.
future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.selector: Strict earliest finite validation raw-RMSE minimum; report MAE, body/tail MAE and recorded-time NLL from that same checkpoint. Last30 epoch mean/SD are stability descriptors, not seed uncertainty.
future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.body_tail: Body target quantity <= all-train p95; tail > all-train p99. Preserve existing all-train strata without validation-based retuning.
future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.decision: Require all frozen gates against both B and event-clock control on both screening datasets. An improvement over B alone does not establish the explicit elapsed-clock contribution.
future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.later_evidence: Only after useful repeatable evidence: component contribution including relation to static LMM, matched benchmark heads/objectives, further seeds, then locked held-out protocol. Single-seed reused validation is not universal superiority.
future_comparison_proposal_not_execution.failure_action: Do not expand seed/dataset scope or tune decay/gates on failure under the same claim; return to the stated hypothesis and the materially different deferred topology.

prior_art_boundary.statement: Continuous-time recurrent state and state-space TPP architectures already exist. The project-specific candidate is a bounded affine interlayer residual with an explicit elapsed-versus-event clock control, not a new general recurrence algorithm.
